candidate_program.name: cheap_density_blend
candidate_program.rationale: Blends reward per conflict with a small heaviest-conflict margin. Uses only base9 inputs with no added graph computation; its pointwise information cannot resolve the witnessed reversal.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.25 * max(0, degree)) + 0.1 * (weight - max_conflict_weight) / (1 + max(0, degree))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
